g.text: 1 Your own actor as a condition
a reader whose only output is answer: yes | no (a fast system-1 judge)
2 Today's chain, written as a workflow (shipped default)
3 Sub-chains (#754): fork and join are step kinds
join: merge the branches; a conflict becomes a merge round that is reviewed; the check runs on the merge.
A child that halts lets its siblings finish, then the parent halts with that reason.
the name resolves top-down, the way actors do
- checked before anything starts: every edge's target exists,
every outcome it matches is one the actor declares
- every loop carries a budget (today's max corrections)
- an outcome with no matching edge halts, with that reason
- the workflow is copied into the chain at start: an edit
- one engine (Next) runs every workflow, shipped or yours:
same trace, same single delivery, same --resume
5 How an actor declares its outcomes
on the actor, next to its agent and candidates; relevo derives the rest
2 the close parses it (any relevo block, newest first)
missing or not in [yes, no] -> the step halts
3 the workflow is checked at start:
edges may only match yes / no; both need an edge
planner: artifact plan (a file, not a value)
